# Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Platform (fictional posting for tests)

## About the role
Example Labs builds support tools for field technicians. You will build retrieval-augmented
generation (RAG) services that answer questions from equipment manuals.

## What you'll do
- Build and evaluate LLM agents that call internal tools
- Ship model serving on Kubernetes with the platform team

## Requirements
- 3+ years of experience with Python and PyTorch
- Production experience with Kubernetes and AWS
- Experience building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems
- Proficiency in Rust for performance-critical services

## Nice to have
- LangGraph or similar agent frameworks
- Ray for distributed training
- Familiarity with vLLM and CUDA
- TypeScript for internal dashboards
